title: Compact settings rename filter review
summary: Settings Save review now renders rename filter term and option changes as compact nested deltas instead of dumping full unchanged filter dictionaries.
reason: Large rename filter objects made the save confirmation dialog hard to read when operators only added or changed a few terms.
behavior_before: Rename filter Settings save rows displayed full JSON dictionaries, including unchanged categories such as audio_channels.
behavior_after: Rename filter Settings save rows show added/removed terms or changed toggles only, while unchanged nested filter values remain hidden and save payloads stay unchanged.
rollback_plan: Revert the settingsSaveReviewCellText rename-filter delta helpers and the matching browser smoke assertions.
notes:
Compact rename filter deltas in Settings save review dialog without changing backend save payloads.
Assert rename filter save review shows changed terms only and hides unchanged filter categories.
Refresh generated summary after Settings save review display change.
Refresh generated summary after WebView rename smoke assertion update.
